sourceNotes.rawContent:
Romantic and chic, this heart band ring adds a golden glow to your everyday or festive look.
Highlights:
- Elegant heart pattern
- Comfortable for daily wear
- A lovely gift for her
Details:
- Plating: Gold Polished
- Material: Brass
- Stones: American Diamonds
Care:
Avoid moisture & chemicals. Clean with a soft cloth after use
